title: Task file front matter
description: The YAML front matter of a repository task file. See the taskmoor task format, spec/README.md (format = 1). Whether `component` names a component in tasks.toml, whether `depends_on` names existing tasks without a cycle, and whether `id` equals the file name's prefix are checked by the reader, not by this schema.

status.description: Only what a person decides on the main branch; in_progress, review, merged and done come from elsewhere.

touches.description: Paths and globs, relative to the repository root, without a leading slash or dot segment.

reviews.description: The most independent review rounds allowed; a failed round counts.

needs_person.description: True when the task needs a person's explicit permission or presence and cannot be finished unattended.

after_release.description: A commit on the main branch that a release of this task's component must contain before the task starts.

profile.description: The agent profile to run the task with; overrides tasks.toml's [routing]. Profile names are defined by the launcher's configuration, not by the format.

model.description: A model name that overrides the chosen profile's model for this task.
